ai_analysis.summary: This promotional post lists SQL topics said to have been asked in American Express interviews for a Data Analyst role. It mentions duplicate detection, INNER JOIN versus OUTER JOIN, finding the second-highest salary, employee-manager salary comparisons with self-joins, RANK() and ROW_NUMBER(), cumulative sums, UNION versus UNION ALL, CTE-based fraud detection, pivoting rows into columns, and year-over-year growth. It provides no worked queries or answers and advises candidates to focus on clean, optimized SQL, logic, clarity, and business understanding.
